requirements.requirement: The system must interpret raw certification status from EVAL-P-MEASURE-BOARD into a normalized boolean state (certified vs not_certified).
The system must map normalized certification state to a display-ready label (e.g., 'Board Certified' or 'Not Board Certified').
The system must normalize issuing authority names into a consistent display format (e.g., abbreviations expanded or standardized).
The system must pass through issuing authority text only after normalization defined in the S1 schema contract.
The system must convert score contribution data into a formatted percentage or point value suitable for UI display.
The system must ensure score contribution formatting aligns with the provider scorecard display conventions used in MessageBubble.
The system must output a structured object conforming exactly to the schema defined in EVAL-P-BOARD-UX-S1.
The system must handle multiple certifications by selecting the primary or most recent certification according to backend-provided ranking or order.
The system must preserve certification status accuracy when backend data includes mixed or conflicting certification entries.
The system must default certification status to 'Not Board Certified' when no valid certification record is present.
The system must return a null or empty issuing authority field when certification data is missing or invalid.
The system must gracefully handle malformed backend certification payloads without breaking the provider scorecard rendering pipeline.
The system must log an error or warning when certification data cannot be parsed into the expected schema.
The system must ensure all output fields required for rendering (status, issuing_body, score_contribution) are always present in the returned object, even if defaulted.
